title: There's something I don't understand about Avery's tile set rules.

posts.author: shiro-tume
posts.body:
Hello.
I would like to use a tileset made by Avery.
However, I have two questions.
① Avery's tileset has a "Free for commercial & non-commercial use, as long as I get a free copy of the game." agreement.
However, there is no contact information, such as an email address, for sending her a free copy of the game.
How should I send her the game?
② It says "free copy of the game", but does this mean that the game is playable?
Or do I need to send all of the game data (including the "picture" and "plugin" folders)?
I'm using Google Translate, so I'm sorry if there are any strange points.
If anyone has used this tileset before and knows how to do it, I'd like you to teach me how.
【日本語/原文】
こんにちは。
私はAveryさんの作ったタイルセットを使わせて頂きたいと思っています。
その上で、分からない点が2つあります。
①Averyさんのタイルセットには、「Free for commercial & non-commercial use, as long as I get a free copy of the game(=ゲームの無料コピーを入手できる限り、非商用での使用は無料です。)」という規約があります。
しかし、彼女にゲームの無料コピーを送るための、メールアドレスなどの連絡先が、どこにも書かれていません。
どうやって彼女にゲームを送れば良いのでしょうか。
②「free copy of the game(=ゲームの無料コピー)」とありますが、これはゲームがプレイできる状態であれば良いのでしょうか。
それとも、ゲームの全てのデータ(「picture」フォルダや「plugin」フォルダを含むもの)を送る必要がありますか？
Google翻訳を使っているので、おかしな点があったらごめんなさい。
このタイルセットを使用したことがある方などの中に、その方法を知っている方がいれば、教えていただきたいです。

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: Avery is here on the forum, so you could send the game here. And, it’s a copy of the complete game, so probably playable!

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body: She means that, if your game is going to be sold commercially, she requires you to send her a steam key or a free copy of your complete game to her. You could just zip your completed project, for example, put it in a google drive and allow her free access through a link you can DM her about.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
shiro-tume said:
② It says "free copy of the game", but does this mean that the game is playable?
Click to expand...
I don't understand the question. What is a game that isn't playable?
shiro-tume said:
Or do I need to send all of the game data (including the "picture" and "plugin" folders)?
Click to expand...
If you export your project and delete any of the folders, it won't work at all.
You can mouse over anyone's name in the forum and click Start Conversation to send them a message privately.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
If you export your project and delete any of the folders, it won't work at all.
Click to expand...
I believe he's asking whether she wants to receive the project folder or the deployed game.
So to answer the question,
@shiro-tume
, she wants the version of the game your customers would receive.
